by_deadline_ACCURACY_BESIDE_NOT_THE_CHEC._register: robot_headline.correct_answers_delivered_by_deadline is an ACCURACY, not an on-time rate: its own `metric` field says correct_answers_delivered_by_deadline, and its definition is the cloud's answer when delivered within the deadline, ELSE THE DEVICE'S if the device's also arrived in time, else a miss. It is NOT the quantity check 2 names, for two separate reasons, and substituting it changes the check twice over. First, an on-time wrong answer scores zero and a correct late answer scores zero, so it is not a deadline-attainment rate. Second, it ADMITS THE DEVICE SIDE, which D177 and D179 (6) exclude: the currency is on-time CLOUD answers only and device_on_time is reported beside, never added. The device floor is 0.371212 on all three arms at seed 4, identical, and the measured consequence is large: on seed 4 the on-time retention is (0.454545 - 0.265152) / (0.893939 - 0.265152) = 0.3012 while the by_deadline retention is (0.545455 - 0.469697) / (0.613636 - 0.469697) = 0.5267, because the accuracy reading compresses the numerator by 2.5x and the denominator by 4.4x. The two are reported side by side and the ON-TIME one is the check.
